info.name: Swapcard GraphQL APIs
info.description: Swapcard is GraphQL-first. Two separate GraphQL endpoints, each with its own access token passed in the Authorization header (no Bearer prefix in Swapcard's documented examples): the Content / Event Admin API at https://developer.swapcard.com/event-admin/graphql and the Exhibitor Leads API at https://developer.swapcard.com/exhibitor/graphql. All operations are GraphQL queries and mutations over HTTP POST. Some request bodies are representative/modeled; the Event query, myExhibitors, myLeads, and scanBadges shapes are grounded in Swapcard docs.
